Domain 1: Sample ML engineering domain

Subdomain 1.1: Choosing managed training tools.

1.A team logs click data to a table named web_clicks and wants churn predictions without writing model code. What should they use?

  1. A.A custom training job on GPUs
  2. B.BigQuery ML with a logistic regression model
  3. C.A self-managed Kubeflow cluster
Show answer & explanation

Correct answer: B � BigQuery ML with a logistic regression model

  • A. Incorrect. Custom training adds code the team wants to avoid.
  • B. Correct. BigQuery ML trains in SQL where the data already lives.
  • C. Incorrect. Running Kubeflow yourself adds upkeep.

Subdomain 1.2: Tuning training cost.

2.A nightly training run on Vertex AI costs too much and finishes late. Which two changes cut both cost and run time? (Select two)(Select 2)

  1. A.Train on Spot VMs with checkpoints
  2. B.Double the number of epochs
  3. C.Cache the preprocessed dataset in Cloud Storage
  4. D.Move training to a larger always-on VM
  5. E.Export the model as a CSV file
Show answer & explanation

Correct answers: A, C � Train on Spot VMs with checkpoints; Cache the preprocessed dataset in Cloud Storage

  • A. Correct. Spot VMs cost less, and checkpoints survive preemption.
  • B. Incorrect. More epochs make the run longer.
  • C. Correct. A cached dataset skips the slow preprocessing step.
  • D. Incorrect. An always-on VM bills between runs.
  • E. Incorrect. A CSV export does not change training.

2.1: Watching models for drift.

3.Prediction quality falls a month after launch while traffic stays flat. What should you check first?

  1. A.The serving region
  2. B.Feature drift against the training data
Show answer & explanation

Correct answer: B � Feature drift against the training data

  • B. Correct. Drift explains a quiet drop in quality.
